annotations.title: DNS lookup, two resolvers, DNSSEC flag

description: [Kyreos, 0.001 USDC per call via x402 on Base] Any DNS record (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA, SRV, PTR), answered by Cloudflare and Google at once. Returns the records with normalized values, whether the two resolvers agree, and whether DNSSEC validated. Same price as single-resolver DNS routes. Input: {"name":"example.com","type":"MX"}. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/dns-check?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.001 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (0.001 USDC on Base)
